records.rationale: The app is the receiving SP endpoint. «Отримує запит ... на надання дескриптора» correctly says it receives the request for a descriptor at the approved URL; it does not say the SP uses the URL to fetch a descriptor elsewhere. This is the corrected schema-default receiver wording. The protected URL remains exact, the approval qualifier remains, and receiving a request is not conflated with descriptor validation or trust acceptance.
